requestBody.query: How to use my Qolsys IQ Panel security system

200.answer:
I can help you with that. Here are some things you can do with your Qolsys IQ Panel security system:

- Arm the system in Stay mode to secure the perimeter of your home.
- Connect to Wi-Fi via the Bell Smart Home app.
- Pair your smartphone using Bluetooth.
